code: import{useState,useMemo,useCallback}from"react";import{useForm}from"react-hook-form";import{useDispatch}from"react-redux";import{createAddressWard,getAddressWardList,updateAddressWard}from"modules/administration/slices/addressWardSlice";import{showSuccessToast}from"common/ToastMessage";import CommonMessage from"common/CommonMessage";const useAddressWardForm=()=>{const dispatch=useDispatch();const[createModalOpen,setCreateModalOpen]=useState(false);const{control,reset,handleSubmit}=useForm({});const onSubmit=useCallback(async(body,editFlag)=>{try{if(editFlag){await dispatch(updateAddressWard({id:body===null||body===void 0?void 0:body.uuid,newData:body})).unwrap();showSuccessToast(CommonMessage.MFS00003.replace("%s","Address Ward"));}else{await dispatch(createAddressWard({...body})).unwrap();showSuccessToast(CommonMessage.MFS00001.replace("%s","Address Ward"));}reset();setCreateModalOpen(false);await dispatch(getAddressWardList({firstFetch:true}));}catch(error){console.error("Error",error);}},[dispatch,reset]);return useMemo(()=>({onSubmit,handleSubmit,control,createModalOpen,setCreateModalOpen:value=>setCreateModalOpen(value),reset}),[onSubmit,handleSubmit,control,createModalOpen,setCreateModalOpen,reset]);};export default useAddressWardForm;
